【原视频简介】
What does it take to make food that soldiers can carry and eat almost anywhere?

U.S. military MREs are engineered to survive storage and harsh conditions, while Shake ’N Bake turns a simple coating mix into a familiar American dinner shortcut. And A.1. combines carefully selected ingredients into its unmistakable steak sauce.

Three very different products—but each depends on precision, consistency, and large-scale food production.

So how are Army MREs, Shake ’N Bake, and A.1. Steak Sauce actually made?

Let’s step inside and find out.
